adaptations.reason: Embed the retained Skills Manager frontend in the operator console.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Imports use the @skills-manager namespace while module behavior remains upstream-equivalent.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Copy the retained frontend tree, reapply only documented adaptations, then regenerate provenance.

adaptations.reason: The feature is mounted below the console's existing URL space.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Skills Manager navigation remains internal to its workspace.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Reapply the BrowserRouter-to-MemoryRouter substitution after each upstream refresh.

adaptations.reason: The feature shares a document with the console.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Theme classes and font variables affect only the Skills Manager workspace.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Retarget only the feature DOM root when refreshing the upstream theme implementation.

adaptations.reason: The console compiles against React 18 types.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Runtime behavior is unchanged while the editor ref type matches the host compiler.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Remove the type-only adaptation when the console adopts React 19.

adaptations.reason: The console uses Tailwind 3 while the retained feature requires Tailwind 4.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: The generated feature stylesheet cannot reset or recolor the console.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Refresh the feature stylesheet, then regenerate its scoped CSS artifact.
